source.section: IT 1040 lines 1 to 8a (bundle PDF p.1); booklet PDF p.16 lines 1 to 4; PDF p.17 line 4 exemption table and line 8a; PDF p.18 bracket table; PDF p.5 rounding; MAGI PDF p.8; MAGI less exemptions worksheet PDF p.40; Schedule of Credits line 2 (PDF p.28; Table 2 PDF p.44; bundle PDF p.7); Department FAQ 2; Schedule of Credits line 12 (PDF p.29)

worked: Federal AGI = private pension person 0 40,000.00 + private pension person 1 20,050.00 = 60,050.00. Federal taxable income = 60,050.00 - standard deduction 31,500.00 = 28,550.00 (given, not tested; the federal senior deduction is ignored; Ohio starts from federal AGI). IT 1040 line 1 federal AGI 60,050.00. Schedule of Adjustments additions: line 1 non-Ohio state or local interest 0.00; line 12 total 0.00; line 2a 0.00. Deductions: none; line 47 total 0.00; line 2b 0.00. Line 3 Ohio AGI = 60,050.00 + 0.00 - 0.00 = 60,050.00. Line 4: MAGI is line 3 with no business income deduction, 60,050.00, in the band 40,001 to 80,000: 2,150.00 each; 2 exemptions x 2,150.00 = 4,300.00. Line 5 = 60,050.00 - 4,300.00 = 55,750.00. Line 6 taxable business income 0.00. Line 7 = 55,750.00. Line 8a tax: 55,750.00 is in the 26,050 to 100,000 band: 342.00 plus 2.750% of (55,750.00 - 26,050.00 = 29,700.00) = 342.00 + 816.75 = 1,158.75. Schedule of Credits line 1 = 1,158.75. MAGI less exemptions (worksheet PDF p.40) = 60,050.00 - 4,300.00 = 55,750.00 (equal to line 7 without business income), under 100,000.00. Line 2 retirement income credit: covered retirement income 60,050.00; 200.00 (Table 2 at 8,001 or more: 200). Line 4 senior citizen credit: no one is 65 or older, 0.00. Line 10 credits = 200.00 + 0.00 = 200.00. Line 11 = 1,158.75 - 200.00 = 958.75. State income tax 958.75. The form works in whole dollars ('Round all figures to the nearest dollar', PDF p.5): line 8a would be 1,159; expected keeps the formula result. Both spouses have retirement income but the maximum is 200 per return. The form also gives the joint filing credit (each spouse has 500 of qualifying income; MAGI less exemptions 55,750 is 10%: 10% x 958.75 = 95.875, tax 862.875); not modelled, so expected stays 958.75.
accepted_approximations: The joint filing credit is not applied (not_modelled).
